chunks: Will you enjoin good deeds on the others and forget your own selves? You also read the Scriptures, why do you then not understand?
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about hypocrisy in teaching others while neglecting oneself?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to critique the scholarly class (Ulama) who prioritize teaching others over self-purification, emphasizing that true authority requires personal adherence to the Book. It underscores the principle that recitation without internalization and practice renders one susceptible to the same hypocrisy as the Children of Israel, serving as a warning against intellectual arrogance without spiritual grounding.
